demographics: Age 70+, Primary Diagnosis: Circulatory (Heart Failure / CAD)

metrics.demographics: Age 70+, Primary Diagnosis: Circulatory (Heart Failure / CAD)

clinical_action_plan.line_1_risk_etiology: Line 1 (Risk Etiology): Advanced age paired with high cardiovascular polypharmacy (15.4 medications) and active dosage titration (44.8% change rate) elevates 30-day readmission to 17.0%.
clinical_action_plan.line_2_in_hospital_protocol: Line 2 (In-Hospital Discharge Protocol): Mandate bedside clinical pharmacist medication reconciliation and bedside heart failure/fluid management education prior to discharge order sign-off.
clinical_action_plan.line_3_post_acute_protocol: Line 3 (Post-Acute Follow-Up Protocol): Schedule transitional telephonic nurse check-in at 48 hours post-discharge and guarantee an in-person cardiology/endocrinology clinic consultation within 7 days.

demographics: Severe Hyperglycemia (A1C >7-8%), Active Insulin Dosage Titration

metrics.demographics: Severe Hyperglycemia (A1C >7-8%), Active Insulin Dosage Titration

clinical_action_plan.line_1_risk_etiology: Line 1 (Risk Etiology): Glycemic volatility requiring rapid insulin titration (41.1% adjustments) leads to post-discharge medication adherence failure and acute hypoglycemia/hyperglycemia relapse (21.1% readmission rate).
clinical_action_plan.line_2_in_hospital_protocol: Line 2 (In-Hospital Discharge Protocol): Deploy Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist (CDCES) for 1-on-1 insulin injection self-management training and provide a 30-day home glucometer kit.
clinical_action_plan.line_3_post_acute_protocol: Line 3 (Post-Acute Follow-Up Protocol): Initiate clinical pharmacist telehealth check-ins on Days 3, 7, and 14 for insulin titration, with an outpatient primary care visit within 10 days.

demographics: High Prior Hospitalization Velocity (>= 2 Inpatient Visits in Prior 12 Months)

metrics.demographics: High Prior Hospitalization Velocity (>= 2 Inpatient Visits in Prior 12 Months)

clinical_action_plan.line_1_risk_etiology: Line 1 (Risk Etiology): Frequent hospitalization history (averaging 2.8 prior inpatient stays) reflects severe disease progression and care coordination fragmentation, resulting in an extreme 33.8% readmission rate.
clinical_action_plan.line_2_in_hospital_protocol: Line 2 (In-Hospital Discharge Protocol): Convene multidisciplinary case management huddle to address social determinants of health (SDOH), transportation barriers, and outpatient prescription affordability.
clinical_action_plan.line_3_post_acute_protocol: Line 3 (Post-Acute Follow-Up Protocol): Assign dedicated community health worker for home visit within 72 hours and enroll in hospital-to-home transitional care management (TCM) program.

demographics: Discharged to Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) / Sub-Acute Rehabilitation

metrics.demographics: Discharged to Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) / Sub-Acute Rehabilitation

clinical_action_plan.line_1_risk_etiology: Line 1 (Risk Etiology): Transition to skilled nursing involves high handover risk, medication transcription errors, and decompensation during physical rehabilitation, driving a 17.5% readmission rate.
clinical_action_plan.line_2_in_hospital_protocol: Line 2 (In-Hospital Discharge Protocol): Implement warm clinical handover with receiving SNF medical director, providing a synchronized 7-day electronic medication reconciliation bundle.
clinical_action_plan.line_3_post_acute_protocol: Line 3 (Post-Acute Follow-Up Protocol): Conduct joint hospitalist-SNF telehealth rounding at 5 days post-transfer to verify clinical stability and prevent acute ER re-transfer.
